title: Surface Relative Threshold Feature
description: Determines whether the provided position is below the estimated surface level of the world, and places a feature if so. If the provided position is above the configured surface or the surface is not available, placement will fail. This feature only works for Overworld generators using world generation 1.18 or later.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The name of this feature in the form 'namespace_name:feature_name'. 'feature_name' must match the filename.

minimum_distance_below_surface.title: Minimum Distance Below Surface
minimum_distance_below_surface.description: The minimum number of blocks required to be between the estimated surface level and a valid place for this feature. Defaults to zero.
